bone.role: Primary light. Text and the top ring segment.

redline.role: Primary accent. Links, highlights, the right ring segment.

ember.role: Deep red. Borders, shadows, the bottom ring segment. Decorative only.

alert.role: Signal. Warnings, calls to action, the slash. Use sparingly.

glow.description: Gaussian blur of the shape merged under the original.

scanlines.description: 2px black lines at 45% opacity, repeating every 6px.
